text_block_list.text:
"Ship of gold, resting beneath the
waves..."

"Now is the time to unleash your true
potential.
Make for the uncharted
territory before you..."

"Go. Go to the radiant land yet
untrodden..."
Urgh... What was that voice just now?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Someone with a whacked out god
complex? Or
maybe it was another
Golshi that awoke in me...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What's this about "uncharted territory,"
anyway?
Uncharted territory...
Uncharted... Ah.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ohhh. I've got it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
This whole message just means "come to
Eden"!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classics, the Satsuki
Sho, is
right around the corner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I need to get Голд Шипп training for it
ASAP!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: OHHH YEEEAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If they need an Umamusume strong
enough to
make it to Eden, then I'll just
have to transcend
mortality!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I... AM... GOD SHIP GOLSHI!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I try to call after her, but Голд Шипп is
already
gone...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Монолог

text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: CRASH!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Who? Who dares bar the
path of
God Ship Golshi?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Oh my.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Golshi. You sure are a ball
of energy
today.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Creek. Of course! I was wondering
what I
could have hit that would be so
soft.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But enough small talk—let me through!
Or I shall
force my way through with
divine authority!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hnnngh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Eat this! Axe Bomber Avalanche!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Thwomp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, what an interesting move! That was
so good,
Golshi! You're very strong.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Impossible! You don't have a scratch on
you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Very well... Let's see if you can handle
this!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hundred-Strike Elbow Smash!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: PA-POW!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why, look at that! Goodness, you are so
talented!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon... That didn't work either?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You've left me no choice. Looks like I
have to use
my secret technique...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Divine Deliverance: Radiant Blade of
Justice!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Whoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... How'd you like them apples?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you must've practiced a lot for
that. What
a hard worker you are!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: H-how is this possible?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I see the truth now... All of creation is
born of
mothers...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What is a mere god to a mommy? I never
stood a
chance...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Despite her determination to become an

Umamusume powerful enough to find
Eden, it's
not enough...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп vs. Супер Крик: defeat! (To
be
continued...)
text_block_list.name: Монолог
